name: Voice AI Platform
description: Complete voice AI assistant platform. Users click a link, talk to your AI, transcripts saved to database. Multi-tenant, embeddable widget, analytics dashboard. Self-hosted or SaaS-ready.
long_description: Turn any business into an AI-powered voice assistant platform. Customers share a link — visitors click and instantly talk to a custom AI assistant powered by ElevenLabs voices and any LLM (OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek). Every conversation is transcribed and stored. Built-in analytics dashboard shows conversation history, sentiment, peak hours. Multi-tenant architecture supports unlimited assistants with custom personalities, knowledge bases, and voice selection. Includes embeddable widget for any website. Perfect for medical offices, real estate, e-commerce support, education, and call centers.
features: Shareable voice chat links — anyone can talk to your AI
Real-time STT → LLM → TTS pipeline (sub-2s latency)
Full transcript storage with search and export
Multi-tenant — unlimited AI assistants per account
Custom personalities, system prompts, and knowledge bases
Embeddable widget (<script> tag for any website)
Analytics dashboard — conversations, sentiment, peak hours
Multi-provider LLM support via LiteLLM (100+ models)
